name: com.verygoodsecurity.api.blinkcard.ScanActivity
description: When a VGS Collect payment form asks to scan a card, the BlinkCard adapter opens the camera scanner and fills the form with the card number, expiry date, security code, and cardholder name it reads.
disableEffect: Card scanning in the payment form will stop working, and the app may not collect payment details if it offers no other entry method.
